# mooncake mod list

List the modules a playbook declares, with cache and lock state

## Description

Lists each alias in the playbook's modules: block with its
reference, whether it is present in the local cache, and whether it is pinned in
mooncake.modules.lock.

This is the playbook's view. For what is in the cache regardless of any
playbook, use `mooncake mod cache list`.

## Flags

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `--playbook` | string | - | Path to the mooncake.yml to read (default: ./mooncake.yml) |
| `--format / -f` | string | `text` | Output format: text or json |
